response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced full-stack and web software engineer with strong breadth across languages and platforms, but he has no demonstrated background in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator hardware, GPU/SIMD architecture, or performance optimization for deep-learning workloads, which are the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role. His experience is almost entirely in web, mobile, and backend application development rather than hardware-software co-design or chip architecture.
strengths: Extensive, long-tenured software engineering career with senior/staff-level titles
Strong low-latency systems experience (DLang, async I/O, high-performance microservices)
Demonstrated leadership via talks, workshops, and open-source project founding
concerns: No evidence of SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture experience
No AI/deep-learning workload optimization or GPU/SIMD architecture background
Career trajectory is entirely web/product engineering, not hardware performance architecture

key_factors.factor: No AI/DL workload or GPU/accelerator optimization background
Strong general software engineering seniority and experience
